extension.description: Open files from inside a Dev Container with the host's default application
command.openFile.title: Open with Default Application
command.revealInFileManager.title: Reveal in File Manager
config.pathMap.description: Explicit mapping from container paths to host paths. Keys are container-side prefixes, values are host-side prefixes. The host path is normally derived from the Dev Container authority, so this is not needed in the usual case. Example: `{"/workspace": "/Users/you/projects/my-repo"}`
